substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2LV6C03 - Vietnamese F-10
substrand_content_descriptions.text: locate information and ideas in a range of spoken, written, viewed and multimodal texts, and respond in different ways to suit purpose
substrand_content_descriptions.sub_strand: Mediating meaning in and between languages

elaborations.name: VC2LV6C03-E01 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: identifying and recording key information from informative or imaginative texts that relate to a particular topic, to provide a summary or to give a live or digital presentation, for example, on tourism in Australia or Vietnam

elaborations.name: VC2LV6C03-E02 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: presenting a critical review of a song, story or television program, using evaluative language such as Em thích câu truyện này vì nó …

elaborations.name: VC2LV6C03-E03 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: identifying and describing key elements of an informative or imaginative text, such as settings, characters or people and events, by asking and responding to questions formed with question words such as ở đâu, khi nào, ai, làm gì, như thế nào and tại sao

elaborations.name: VC2LV6C03-E04 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: listening to, reading or viewing Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander stories and responding to them using words, formulaic expressions and modelled sentences in Vietnamese

elaborations.name: VC2LV6C03-E05 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: reading or viewing imaginative texts in print, digital or multimodal forms, such as poems, cartoons, stories, folktales or films, and performing scenes that illustrate aspects of a character’s attitudes, personality or reactions, for example, in a story such as ‘Câu chuyện Kiến và Voi’

elaborations.name: VC2LV6C03-E06 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: viewing an extract of text and selecting pictures, colours, symbols or emoticons to express the content, mood or key message of the text

elaborations.name: VC2LV6C03-E07 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: viewing a series of images of different celebrations and festivities, using a ‘see-think-wonder’ thinking routine to reflect on the images, and then developing written captions for the images using adjectives and nouns

elaborations.name: VC2LV6C03-E08 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: identifying variations in aspects of language use, such as tone, gesture, word choice or sentence structure in different contexts, and using these in their own guided interactions, for example, watching conversations between a customer and salesperson, doctor and patient, and tour guide and tourist, and then replicating this language in a role-play

elaborations.name: VC2LV6C03-E09 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: describing their reactions to informative or imaginative texts that evoke responses such as sadness, fear or excitement, relating them to their own experiences, for example, Em cũng cảm thấy …

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2LV6C04 - Vietnamese F-10
substrand_content_descriptions.text: apply strategies to interpret and convey meaning and/or intercultural understanding in Vietnamese in familiar non-verbal, spoken and written contexts
substrand_content_descriptions.sub_strand: Mediating meaning in and between languages

elaborations.name: VC2LV6C04-E01 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: identifying words or phrases that are difficult to translate and possible reasons for this, such as food items (e.g. bánh chưng, bánh tét, bánh xèo, phở) or traditional customs (e.g. cúng ông bà, cúng mụ, xin xăm, xem bói, coi ngày tốt xấu, so đôi tuổi)

elaborations.name: VC2LV6C04-E02 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: recognising differences in language use between formal and informal conversations, such as class presentations and everyday conversations, for example, Xin chào cô và các bạn versus Lan nè / Ê Lan, khỏe không?

elaborations.name: VC2LV6C04-E03 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: learning to use bilingual print dictionaries and online translation apps responsibly to work out the meaning of unfamiliar words or sentences, and determining the reliability of these aids to accurately translate information

elaborations.name: VC2LV6C04-E04 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: describing elements of Vietnamese language that are different from English, including pronunciation, gestures and facial expressions, and sharing what they find difficult or awkward when using each language

elaborations.name: VC2LV6C04-E05 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: identifying context-specific language, for example, at the market (e.g. giá bao nhiêu, trả giá, mắc/đắt, rẻ, giảm giá, hàng tốt/xấu) or a doctor’s surgery (e.g. bị cảm, ho, nhức đầu, chóng mặt)

elaborations.name: VC2LV6C04-E06 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: interpreting a range of simple texts, including idioms to identify the main meaning, for example, Tiên học lễ, hậu học văn; Gần mực thì đen, gần đèn thì rạng/sáng; Yêu cho roi cho vọt, ghét cho ngọt cho bùi; Ăn vóc học hay/bền

elaborations.name: VC2LV6C04-E07 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: making and using bilingual resources for language learning, such as glossaries of cultural terms in Vietnamese and English to inform Vietnamese and Australian visitors about events in each country, such as Vietnamese New Year’s celebrations, Moon Festival, food festivals, boat racing festivals, Mother’s Day, Father’s Day, Anzac Day and Christmas, and explaining culture-specific elements

elaborations.name: VC2LV6C04-E08 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: examining the risks of literal or word-for-word translations when translating expressions, idioms and proverbs, for example, ‘full of beans’ (lively and energetic) may be translated incorrectly in Vietnamese as đầy đậu

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2LV6C05 - Vietnamese F-10
substrand_content_descriptions.text: create and present spoken and written texts, using a variety of vocabulary, modelled sentence structures and conventions appropriate to text type

elaborations.name: VC2LV6C05-E01 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: creating texts for a range of audiences and purposes, for example, a recount of the Grade 5 camp for a school newsletter, an invitation for parents to attend the Grade 6 information evening, or a review of the latest movie for peers

elaborations.name: VC2LV6C05-E02 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: explaining to others a procedure or practice, for example, community recycling, a recipe, health-care tips, a tutorial on the rules of a sport or game, or eating etiquette

elaborations.name: VC2LV6C05-E03 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: composing bilingual resources for the school community, such as posters for class or school performances, displays or events, for example, Ngày hội Thể thao (Sports Carnival), Ngày hội Đa Văn hóa (Multicultural Day) or a virtual tour of the school with signs, notices, labels and short comments in Vietnamese and English, for example, Thư viện (Library), Hội trường (Hall), Xin giữ im lặng! (Quiet please!)

elaborations.name: VC2LV6C05-E04 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: creating a class print or digital poster, locating and describing, in Vietnamese, a specific Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Country or Place location in their local or regional area, or elsewhere in Australia

elaborations.name: VC2LV6C05-E05 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: creating a simple, alternative ending for a Vietnamese imaginative text such as a folktale or short story

elaborations.name: VC2LV6C05-E06 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: writing and recording a story in the form of a photo slideshow, using modelled language and speech bubbles, captions, subtitles, images, or other audio or visual aids to enhance effect

elaborations.name: VC2LV6C05-E07 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: composing and participating in imagined interactions with characters from familiar texts, for example, a conversation between characters or meeting a character from a Vietnamese story or film for the first time, for example, Con chào chú, rất vui được nói/trò chuyện với chú. Con rất thích chú trong vai Lê Lai, chú trông thiệt oai phong và dũng cảm.

elaborations.name: VC2LV6C05-E08 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: producing and performing short, scripted plays to retell a traditional folktale in a modern context, for example, diễn kịch cô Tấm thử hài

elaborations.name: VC2LV6C05-E09 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: creating bilingual videos to teach others informal Vietnamese and English expressions for everyday interactions with teachers, friends and family

elaborations.name: VC2LV6C05-E10 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: sharing information with peers or family members in Vietnamese-speaking communities overseas, for example, via a video clip or secure, teacher-moderated blog, introducing aspects of local culture, including interesting places, people and lifestyle, for example, phương tiện giao thông, cuộc sống của người thành thị và nông thôn, xã hội Đa văn hóa

elaborations.name: VC2LV6C05-E11 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: using graphs or tables in print or digital form to present information, for example, creating a pie chart to represent the benefits of being bilingual or learning Vietnamese

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2LV6U01 - Vietnamese F-10
substrand_content_descriptions.text: apply combinations of sounds, tone, pronunciation and intonation patterns to develop fluency and rhythm in words, phrases and sentences

elaborations.name: VC2LV6U01-E01 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: understanding the variability of sound–letter combinations and distinguishing between similar sounds such as ch and tr in chai/trai, or s and x in song/xong

elaborations.name: VC2LV6U01-E02 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: applying pronunciation rules, including adding or changing tone marks, initial consonants or vowels to form new words, for example, buổi, cuối, đuổi, tuổi, chuối, muỗi

elaborations.name: VC2LV6U01-E03 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: exploring Vietnamese sounds such as homophones (e.g. dai/dây; giai/giây) and homonyms such as bàn (bàn bạc) and bàn (cái bàn)

elaborations.name: VC2LV6U01-E04 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: understanding and reproducing Vietnamese words with different tone marks and pitch (e.g. thương, thường, thưởng, thượng)

elaborations.name: VC2LV6U01-E05 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: using digital tools to check the correct pronunciation of Vietnamese, and using voice-recording software to check their own tone and intonation to develop fluency

elaborations.name: VC2LV6U01-E06 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: understanding that Vietnamese has different regional accents, such as Northern, Central and Southern Vietnamese, for example, mẹ/mạ/má; bố/ba/tía; dứa/thơm/khóm

elaborations.name: VC2LV6U01-E07 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: understanding rhythm in sentences, using pauses and intonation to signal clause boundaries and emphasis, for example, Học bài, không được bỏ đi chơi vs. Học bài không được, bỏ đi chơi

elaborations.name: VC2LV6U01-E08 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: applying Vietnamese pronunciation and intonation, recognising how pitch, stress and rhythm help to convey meaning, for example, Anh ăn trưa chưa? / Anh chưa ăn trưa? / Anh chưa ăn trưa.

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2LV6U02 - Vietnamese F-10
substrand_content_descriptions.text: recognise and use a range of modelled grammatical structures to respond to and create simple texts using conventions appropriate to text type

elaborations.name: VC2LV6U02-E01 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: using appropriate punctuation in writing, including commas, full stops, question marks, semicolons, colons, quotation marks and exclamation marks

elaborations.name: VC2LV6U02-E02 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: applying Vietnamese spelling rules, for example, k, gh and ngh only go with i, e and ê in kiến, kẻ, kể, ghi, ghe, ghế, nghỉ, nghe and nghệ

elaborations.name: VC2LV6U02-E03 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: identifying Vietnamese words ending with i or y that have different meanings, for example, tai and tay; mai and may; ngài and ngày

elaborations.name: VC2LV6U02-E04 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: understanding the grammatical function of adjectives, nouns, verbs and adverbs in sentences

elaborations.name: VC2LV6U02-E05 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: using adverbs and adjectives to expand and elaborate on meaning in sentences, for example, adverbs such as hát hay, học giỏi and làm việc nhanh nhẹn / chậm chạp; adjectives such as người con ngoan ngoãn / có hiếu and căn phòng sạch sẽ / ngăn nắp

elaborations.name: VC2LV6U02-E06 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: exploring a range of comparative and superlative forms of adjectives (e.g. đẹp, đẹp hơn, đẹp nhất)

elaborations.name: VC2LV6U02-E07 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: using different types of compound words (e.g. nhà cửa, đường phố, trường lớp, anh chị em), and understanding how they are formed, for example, trường + học = trường học; học + hành = học hành

elaborations.name: VC2LV6U02-E08 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: extending vocabulary by learning and using reduplicative words (e.g. nho nhỏ, to to, đo đỏ)

elaborations.name: VC2LV6U02-E09 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: using prepositions to indicate location (e.g. trong, ngoài, trên, dưới, bên phải, bên trái, bên cạnh, trước, sau, ở giữa)

elaborations.name: VC2LV6U02-E10 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: exploring and using synonyms (e.g. to – lớn; nhỏ – bé; siêng năng – chăm chỉ) and antonyms (e.g. tốt – xấu; mới – cũ; ngày – đêm; nóng – lạnh; hiền – dữ; giàu – nghèo)

elaborations.name: VC2LV6U02-E11 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: applying basic sentence structure in spoken and written texts, for example, the ‘subject + predicate’ sentence structure

elaborations.name: VC2LV6U02-E12 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: creating modelled affirmative, negative and interrogative sentences, for example, Tôi thích chơi thể thao. Mình không thích chơi thể thao. Bạn thích môn thể thao nào?

elaborations.name: VC2LV6U02-E13 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: using conjunctions to link words, phrases or sentences (e.g. và, với, hay, tại vì, hoặc, tuy, nhưng)

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2LV6U03 - Vietnamese F-10
substrand_content_descriptions.text: compare Vietnamese language structures and features with those of English and/or other languages, using familiar metalanguage

elaborations.name: VC2LV6U03-E01 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: exploring the influence of English on informal language used in daily interactions by Vietnamese people in Australia, for example, đi (shop), xem (TV), nghe (radio) and dùng (internet), and the use of terms such as ‘OK’, ‘hello’ and ‘shopping’

elaborations.name: VC2LV6U03-E02 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: recognising that many Vietnamese words are derived from other languages, including French (ba lê, cà phê), English (internet, căn-tin) and Chinese (phụ huynh, tổ quốc)

elaborations.name: VC2LV6U03-E03 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: identifying and comparing the language features of different text types in Vietnamese and English, such as descriptive language in narratives or persuasive language in advertisements

elaborations.name: VC2LV6U03-E04 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: discussing aspects of grammar using metalanguage in Vietnamese or English, for example, danh từ / noun, động từ / verb, tính từ / adjective, chủ ngữ / subject, vị ngữ / predicate

elaborations.name: VC2LV6U03-E05 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: comparing the structural features of familiar personal, informative and imaginative Vietnamese and English texts, for example, dates on diary entries and letters, greetings in emails or conversations, and titles of stories

elaborations.name: VC2LV6U03-E06 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: comparing different types of texts such as recipes, songs, stories, recounts or conversations to identify audience and purpose used in both Vietnamese and English

elaborations.name: VC2LV6U03-E07 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: understanding how to create textual cohesion by using elements such as adverbs of sequence (e.g. thứ nhất, thứ nhì, trước tiên, kế đến, rồi, sau cùng), and conjunctions (e.g. và, với, hay, hoặc, vì, nhưng) to sequence and link ideas, and comparing how these work with English

elaborations.name: VC2LV6U03-E08 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: creating comparative lists of vocabulary in Vietnamese and English, which can be used in different contexts, for example, the use of imperatives in a set of instructions (e.g. Đứng lên!; Ngồi xuống!; Mở tập/vở ra!; Nghe và lặp lại), or the frequent use of time and place markers (e.g. ngày xửa ngày xưa, hôm qua, hôm nay, ngày mai, tuần tới) in narratives

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2LV6U04 - Vietnamese F-10
substrand_content_descriptions.text: recognise that language reflects cultural practices, values and identity, and that this has an impact on verbal, non-verbal and written communication
substrand_content_descriptions.sub_strand: Understanding the interrelationship of language and culture

elaborations.name: VC2LV6U04-E01 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: recognising the interconnections between cultural practices and language use in Vietnamese and demonstrating cultural awareness when using Vietnamese, for example, using Dạ and thưa or different personal pronouns to indicate politeness, or adding ông, bà, thầy or cô before Vietnamese names, rather than addressing adults with only their given names, to show respect

elaborations.name: VC2LV6U04-E02 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: noticing that language varies between regions, for example, ốm means ‘sick’ in Northern Vietnamese and ‘thin’ in Southern Vietnamese; bông means ‘cotton’ in Northern Vietnamese and ‘flowers’ in Southern Vietnamese; the words ‘what’, ‘where’, ‘that’, ‘why’ and ‘thus’ are chi, mô, tê, răng and rứa in Central Vietnamese and gì, đâu, kìa, sao and vậy in Northern and Southern Vietnamese

elaborations.name: VC2LV6U04-E03 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: discussing connections between the Vietnamese language and cultural beliefs, for example, con số hên / số đẹp; ngày tốt / tốt ngày; con Rồng cháu Tiên; Khéo ăn thì no, khéo co thì ấm; Trời nắng tốt dưa, trời mưa tốt lúa

elaborations.name: VC2LV6U04-E04 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: discussing how language and culture are expressed through song, dance or artworks in Vietnamese-speaking communities, and noticing similarities and differences with Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander communities

elaborations.name: VC2LV6U04-E05 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: practising Vietnamese table manners, for example, not eating until the adult starts eating and saying Con mời ba mẹ / ông bà or mời bạn/chị/anh, making no noise from the mouth when eating, learning chopstick manners, and serving with the other end of chopsticks

elaborations.name: VC2LV6U04-E06 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: exploring how language carries cultural ideas, for example, Tết Nguyên đán = Lunar New Year; Tết Trung thu = Mid-Autumn Festival; đám giỗ = death anniversary; thôi nôi = 1st birthday, đầy tháng = celebration of the first month of birth

elaborations.name: VC2LV6U04-E07 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: identifying ways in which Vietnamese language and culture influence the lives of Australians, such as Vietnamese cuisine (e.g. nem, phở, bánh mì) and fashion (e.g. áo dài, nón lá)

elaborations.name: VC2LV6U04-E08 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: understanding the meaning of ‘culture’, how it involves visible elements such as language, symbols, food, national costumes and dancing, and less-visible elements such as attitudes, beliefs and values, and comparing these elements of Vietnamese culture in the Northern, Central and Southern Vietnamese regions, as well as other cultures of Asia

elaborations.name: VC2LV6U04-E09 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: exploring examples of traditional and contemporary images or texts in print and online, and discussing how identity and gender are represented in the language

curriculum_band_description.body:
In Levels 7 and 8, Vietnamese language learning builds on each student’s prior learning and experiences. They work increasingly independently and in groups, and continue to receive feedback and support from their peers and teachers. Students use Vietnamese, in person or in secure, teacher-moderated online environments, to interact and collaborate within and beyond the classroom. They listen, speak, read, write and view to exchange information, ideas and opinions about their worlds. Background language learners and second or additional language learners may also interact and collaborate within and beyond the classroom to facilitate learning.

Students access a range of spoken, written, viewed and multimodal texts from a variety of authentic sources, which may include audio and video clips, magazines, advertisements, images, stories and articles. Background language learners may source texts and other resources from their local community to share with peers.

Students use their knowledge of some metalanguage in an increasing range of contexts to reflect on similarities and differences between Vietnamese, English and/or other language structures and features. They recognise that language choices reflect cultural values, beliefs and identity.

curriculum_achievement_standard.body:
By the end of Level 8, students initiate and maintain Vietnamese-language interactions in familiar and some unfamiliar contexts related to a range of interests and experiences. They use Vietnamese to collaborate and problem-solve, and adjust their language in response to others. They interpret information, ideas and opinions in texts. They demonstrate understanding of the similarities and differences between languages, in both familiar and some unfamiliar contexts, by adjusting and reorganising responses. They sequence information and ideas, and select and use vocabulary, sentence structures and expressions to create texts appropriate to context, purpose and audience.

Students apply the conventions of spoken Vietnamese and continue to enhance fluency. They demonstrate understanding that spoken, written, viewed and multimodal texts use different conventions, structures and features to convey meaning. They comment on structures and features of Vietnamese text, using some metalanguage. They reflect on how the Vietnamese language, culture and identity are interconnected and compare this with their own language(s), culture(s) and identity.

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2LV8C01 - Vietnamese F-10
substrand_content_descriptions.text: initiate and sustain exchanges in familiar and some unfamiliar contexts related to their experiences, feelings and views, adjusting their language in response to others

elaborations.name: VC2LV8C01-E01 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: sustaining face-to-face and secure, teacher-moderated online conversations, for example, encouraging responses through questions such as Ngoài âm nhạc, bạn còn có sở thích gì khác? Tại sao vậy?; Tôi nghĩ đọc sách rất có ích. Bạn có đồng ý với tôi không?; Bạn thích xem phim hay đọc sách hơn? Tại sao?

elaborations.name: VC2LV8C01-E02 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: sharing information and opinions with peers in class and in online communities about a range of topics such as friends, family, lifestyles, celebrations, food and health, for example, Mình nên cẩn thận khi làm/kết bạn ở trên mạng; Chúng ta nên ăn uống lành mạnh để có sức khỏe tốt; Chúng ta nên tôn trọng mọi người xung quanh; Chúng ta nên lễ phép với thầy cô giáo

elaborations.name: VC2LV8C01-E03 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: using descriptive language to discuss contrasting aspects of their personal worlds such as home and school, study and entertainment or discipline and freedom, and justifying opinions, for example, Chúng ta nói tiếng Anh với thầy cô và bạn bè ở trường nhưng nên nói tiếng Việt ở nhà; Chúng ta nên biết cân bằng giữa việc học và giải trí; Gia đình tôi sống rất hòa thuận và vui vẻ; Cuối tuần tôi thường đi bơi hay đi xem phim với bạn bè

elaborations.name: VC2LV8C01-E04 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: asking and responding to open-ended questions about learning activities or strategies, for example, Mình phải làm sao để phân biệt được các dấu trong tiếng Việt? Bạn phải cố gắng tập nghe, tập đọc và tập viết cho nhiều và chú ý cách phát âm.

elaborations.name: VC2LV8C01-E05 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: summarising different opinions in interactions, for example, Có bạn thì thích phim hành động, có bạn thì thích xem hài kịch

elaborations.name: VC2LV8C01-E06 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: acknowledging others’ ideas and opinions and indicating agreement or disagreement in non-judgemental ways, for example, Tôi hiểu ý của bạn nhưng bạn nghĩ sao nếu …

elaborations.name: VC2LV8C01-E07 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: requesting repetition or asking for and providing clarification, for example, Bạn vui lòng lặp lại / nói lại …?; Bạn vui lòng nói rõ hơn về …?; Bạn nghĩ sao về việc …?; Thưa cô, chữ ‘vẻ mặt’ là dấu hỏi hay dấu ngã?; Thưa thầy, chữ “xin lỗi” dùng dấu ngã phải không ạ?

elaborations.name: VC2LV8C01-E08 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: initiating written exchanges such as writing to a student in Vietnam, requesting information and responding appropriately, for example, Ở Việt Nam, bạn ăn Tết trong bao lâu? Bên Úc, gia đình mình chỉ ăn Tết vào ngày cuối tuần.

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2LV8C02 - Vietnamese F-10
substrand_content_descriptions.text: use language to negotiate and problem-solve collaboratively to plan projects and events

elaborations.name: VC2LV8C02-E01 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: participating in authentic cultural experiences in the community, such as an excursion to a Vietnamese restaurant or festival, and rehearsing studied vocabulary, structures and manners, for example, Mình nên dùng món khai vị gì?; Còn món ăn chính thì sao?; Chúng ta nên ăn tráng miệng bằng trái cây thay cho bánh ngọt; Các bạn nhớ đừng nói chuyện ồn ào khi ăn uống

elaborations.name: VC2LV8C02-E02 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: collaborating to decide on a menu for a class lunch and negotiating items, prices and delivery with a local restaurant, for example, Lớp chúng ta nên nấu món gì cho Ngày hội Đa Văn hoá? Cơm chiên và chả giò được không? Mình cần chuẩn bị những gì?

elaborations.name: VC2LV8C02-E03 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: planning and making arrangements for activities such as outings, using expressions related to place, time and numbers, for example, Các bạn muốn hẹn gặp nhau ở đâu?; Mấy giờ thì mình sẽ đi leo núi?; Mình gặp nhau lúc bảy giờ sáng được không?

elaborations.name: VC2LV8C02-E04 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: collaborating to create a short children’s story based on a Vietnamese cultural event such as Tết, and reading it to younger learners of Vietnamese

elaborations.name: VC2LV8C02-E05 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: collaborating to create displays, presentations or performances for family, friends or the school community to showcase Vietnamese learning, for example, singing a song or reciting a poem in Vietnamese (e.g. 'Xin chào Việt Nam', 'Việt Nam quê hương tôi', 'Quê hương ba miền', 'Hồn quê')

elaborations.name: VC2LV8C02-E06 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: participating in a collaborative project such as contributing to a school newsletter, a secure, teacher-moderated blog or a poster to promote awareness of an important issue, for example, creating posters to promote Vietnamese language and culture, and displaying them in local libraries and primary schools

elaborations.name: VC2LV8C02-E07 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: conducting interviews with Vietnamese-speaking residents in nursing homes on various topics (e.g. migration, life experiences in Australia, career choices, family history), and preparing a presentation using digital tools and apps

elaborations.name: VC2LV8C02-E08 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: providing feedback using metalanguage to support peers, for example, editing each other's written or spoken texts and work samples, and justifying reasons for editing or changing text

elaborations.name: VC2LV8C02-E09 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: creating resources to help others, such as a set of helpful hints for new Vietnamese-speaking students or students starting school, travelling to Vietnam for the first time, or teaching a skill step by step

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2LV8C03 - Vietnamese F-10
substrand_content_descriptions.text: interpret information, ideas and opinions in a range of spoken, written, viewed and multimodal texts, and respond appropriately to context, purpose and audience
substrand_content_descriptions.sub_strand: Mediating meaning in and between languages

elaborations.name: VC2LV8C03-E01 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: reading and viewing a range of digital and printed texts about Vietnamese special occasions and ceremonies, identifying key points and discussing culture-specific terms and representations, such as Ở Úc, người ta không ăn Tết nhiều ngày như ở Việt Nam

elaborations.name: VC2LV8C03-E02 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: using reading and viewing strategies to understand and respond to multimodal texts, for example, identifying the gist of an informative text about climate change and responding with a personal action or opinion, such as Mọi gia đình nên tái chế rác thải để bảo vệ môi trường

elaborations.name: VC2LV8C03-E03 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: viewing a series of images showing people participating in celebrations or festivities, completing a ‘word-phrase-sentence’ thinking routine using information from the images, and then discussing their notes with a partner

elaborations.name: VC2LV8C03-E04 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: accessing a range of digital and other texts, such as books, advertising images, films, photographs, videos, drama, drawings, webpages, documentaries, news items or interviews, to collate and present information about aspects of Vietnamese and Australian lifestyles, for example, creating a multimodal presentation on Vietnamese teenagers’ fashion and tastes in music

elaborations.name: VC2LV8C03-E05 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: discussing the ways words can be misinterpreted, for example, the naming of the Barwon River in English (Wadawurrung word Parwan for ‘magpie’), or the Yarra River (Wurundjeri term Yarro Yarro, meaning ‘It flows’), and identifying false friends or commonly misunderstood terms and phrases in Vietnamese that can cause miscommunication

elaborations.name: VC2LV8C03-E06 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: responding to a narrative by writing and performing a simple monologue of a main character, demonstrating empathy

elaborations.name: VC2LV8C03-E07 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: researching and comparing aspects of life in Vietnam and Australia, and presenting this information, for example, researching and comparing ways of transport in Vietnam and Australia and presenting this information in a table

elaborations.name: VC2LV8C03-E08 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: listening to, viewing and reading a range of texts, including multimodal and digital narratives, such as cartoons, films, comics, stories, poems and songs, and identifying themes, messages and plot, for example, the myth 'Sơn Tinh – Thủy Tinh', the poem 'Làm anh' and the song 'Xin chào Việt Nam'

elaborations.name: VC2LV8C03-E09 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: identifying differences between language use in formal interviews and speeches, and in everyday conversations, and replicating these differences in their own speeches or conversations (e.g. Vui lòng cho biết ý kiến của bạn về vấn đề này? vs. Bạn nghĩ sao về chuyện này?; Xin chào cô và các bạn vs. Lan nè / Ê Lan, khỏe không?)

elaborations.name: VC2LV8C03-E10 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: identifying alliteration in Vietnamese texts (e.g. vui vẻ; mát mẻ; lanh lợi), and using this in their own creative texts

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2LV8C04 - Vietnamese F-10
substrand_content_descriptions.text: apply strategies to comprehend and produce non-verbal, spoken and written language to convey meaning and intercultural understanding in familiar and some unfamiliar contexts
substrand_content_descriptions.sub_strand: Mediating meaning in and between languages

elaborations.name: VC2LV8C04-E01 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: discussing strategies for translating difficult words and concepts, such as expanding descriptions or explanations, providing examples to assist meaning or connecting to context to identify the meaning of a word, for example, reading the sentence ‘That tea is strong’ and working out from the context that the meaning of ‘strong’ is đậm, not khỏe

elaborations.name: VC2LV8C04-E02 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: comparing choices of language and behaviours when communicating in Vietnamese and English, explaining the modifications they make and why, for example, being indirect when making refusals in Vietnamese-speaking contexts (e.g. Dạ con không dám hứa; Chắc để con xem lại; Con cũng thích món quà này nhưng mà …), or using both hands when giving something to show respect

elaborations.name: VC2LV8C04-E03 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: comparing their own translations of short texts with those of their classmates, and then comparing both to versions produced by bilingual digital or print dictionaries, discussing reasons for variations and discrepancies, for example, phi trường / sân bay; ga tàu / trạm xe lửa

elaborations.name: VC2LV8C04-E04 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: reflecting on and explaining which words, expressions or gestures should or should not be incorporated when interacting with Vietnamese speakers or speakers of other languages, for example, using expressions of praise or admiration, beckoning downwards or upwards, hugging someone in greeting, or making or avoiding eye contact during conversation

elaborations.name: VC2LV8C04-E05 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: understanding how to convert informal spoken language such as ai cũng biết hết into the formal register to suit particular purposes and audiences, and experimenting with formal expressions such as mọi người đều biết and như các bạn đã biết

elaborations.name: VC2LV8C04-E06 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: discussing and amending inaccurate translations of public signs or notices in Vietnam and in Australia, for example, ‘roundabout’ is bùng binh, not vòng tròn

elaborations.name: VC2LV8C04-E07 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: recognising changes required for sentence structure or word use in English–Vietnamese translation, for example, This lesson is too hard to understand – Bài học này khó quá, tôi không hiểu được; I can’t help laughing – Tôi không thể nhịn cười được

elaborations.name: VC2LV8C04-E08 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: interpreting examples of colloquialisms or slang typically used by young people, such as gấu (partner) and toang (broken)

elaborations.name: VC2LV8C04-E09 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: comparing humour in Vietnamese comedies with Australian/Western expressions of humour, for example, comparing comedies by Anh Đỗ with Mr Bean and discussing personal responses

elaborations.name: VC2LV8C04-E10 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: creating Vietnamese glossaries to accompany English texts, such as dự báo thời tiết (weather forecasts), phim tài liệu về thiên nhiên (nature documentary), phim hoạt hình (cartoons), blog du lịch (travel blog) or truyện cổ tích (folktales)

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2LV8C05 - Vietnamese F-10
substrand_content_descriptions.text: create and present spoken and written texts, sequencing information and ideas, selecting vocabulary, expressions and grammatical structures appropriate to text type and context

elaborations.name: VC2LV8C05-E01 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: reporting, in the form of a recount, a secure, teacher-moderated blog or a multimodal presentation, a personal experience such as a school excursion, a holiday or a local cultural event, using descriptive captions, subtitles or other audiovisual aids to enhance effect

elaborations.name: VC2LV8C05-E02 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: composing bilingual texts for non-Vietnamese and non-English speakers, for example, menus for Vietnamese restaurants with footnotes in English, or public signs and notices for Vietnamese and Australian contexts, paying attention to aspects of culture

elaborations.name: VC2LV8C05-E03 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: producing an informative text introducing an aspect of their immediate environment or personal worlds, for example, creating a tour of their school, a guide to their favourite place, an itinerary for young Australian travellers to Vietnam, a history of their town, or an explanation of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander place names and information about cultural practices, including keywords and key phrases, for example, Bao nhiêu tiền?; Làm ơn chở tôi đến nhà hàng / khách sạn / phi trường; Xin lỗi; Cám ơn

elaborations.name: VC2LV8C05-E04 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: writing texts such as a diary entry to reflect on an event in a story or film, or an imagined interview with a character from a story or film

elaborations.name: VC2LV8C05-E05 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: performing in or creating a multimedia video clip of a dramatisation of a creative text, for example, imagining themselves as characters in a poem, song or painting, and creating a scenario and dialogue, such as the poem 'Làm anh' or the song 'Xin chào Việt Nam'

elaborations.name: VC2LV8C05-E06 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: adapting stories or films to new settings and contexts, imagining how characters might behave and react in different contexts and times

elaborations.name: VC2LV8C05-E07 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: creating the next scene, a new character or an alternative ending for Vietnamese imaginative texts such as a folktale, short story, drama or film (e.g. 'Ăn khế trả vàng'; 'Sơn Tinh – Thuỷ Tinh')

elaborations.name: VC2LV8C05-E08 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: creating jingles or songs to well-known or original tunes to entertain peers or a younger audience, for example, choosing a tune from a famous pop song and using key language to create a new song

elaborations.name: VC2LV8C05-E09 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: creating captions, commentaries or subtitles for short video clips or slideshow presentations of intercultural experiences, such as going on a holiday, attending a wedding ceremony, giving or accepting a gift, or informing Vietnamese-speaking peers and a local Vietnamese-speaking community of school or cultural events

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2LV8U01 - Vietnamese F-10
substrand_content_descriptions.text: apply conventions of spoken Vietnamese including sounds and tones to enhance fluency, and to respond to and create texts in familiar and some unfamiliar contexts

elaborations.name: VC2LV8U01-E01 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: applying Vietnamese pronunciation and spelling rules to their own speech and writing to pronounce and spell new words encountered in interactions and texts, for example, if the spelling of the word mười is known, then the spelling of the word người can be determined without knowing its meaning

elaborations.name: VC2LV8U01-E02 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: experimenting with intonation patterns to distinguish different types of sentences such as statements, questions and exclamations, for example, Con không đi chơi đâu. / Con không đi chơi đâu? / Con không đi chơi đâu!

elaborations.name: VC2LV8U01-E03 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: distinguishing and making nuances in pronunciation and spelling between some similar diphthongs and triphthongs, for example, chiều cao and cây cau; lỗ mũi and con muỗi; cái túi and trái chuối

elaborations.name: VC2LV8U01-E04 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: developing features of spoken Vietnamese, including intonation, tone and stress, to increase fluency and enhance expression in a range of activities such as listening to and repeating pronunciation, using digital tools, reading aloud and conversing with a wide range of people

elaborations.name: VC2LV8U01-E05 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: listening to short interactions between unfamiliar voices at diverse speeds or levels of clarity to develop auditory and comprehension skills

elaborations.name: VC2LV8U01-E06 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: developing strategies to understand meaning when listening to diverse regional Vietnamese accents, for example, inferring meaning from the context

elaborations.name: VC2LV8U01-E07 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: practising ways in which intonation varies according to setting and context, for example, saying the same sentence in different tones (e.g. friendly/unfriendly, respectful/ironic) to change the meaning, such as Hôm nay, em tới sớm thế!

elaborations.name: VC2LV8U01-E08 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: comparing their own Vietnamese speech patterns with Modern Standard Vietnamese pronunciation, and making adjustments to their pronunciation of certain sounds or tone marks as necessary, for example, g and r; s and x; ch and tr; d, gi and v

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2LV8U02 - Vietnamese F-10
substrand_content_descriptions.text: apply understanding of grammatical structures to respond to and create a range of texts using conventions appropriate to audience and text type

elaborations.name: VC2LV8U02-E01 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: understanding and applying punctuation in writing, or adhering to punctuation conventions in reading, for example, full stops, commas, exclamation marks, brackets, apostrophes, quotation marks and question marks

elaborations.name: VC2LV8U02-E02 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: exploring homonyms encountered in texts, such as bò (cow / to crawl), ăn (eat / to win), đỗ/đậu (to pass an exam / bean), bàn (table / to discuss), lợi (to benefit / gum) and đá (to kick / ice)

elaborations.name: VC2LV8U02-E03 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: understanding the use of được and bị for positive and negative meanings, for example, Em được điểm tốt; Em được thầy cô khen; Em bị bệnh; Cành cây bị gãy

elaborations.name: VC2LV8U02-E04 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: understanding and using verbs to express modality (e.g. nên, cần and phải), for example, Các em nên chăm học; Chúng ta cần không khí để thở; Học sinh phải mặc đồng phục khi đi học

elaborations.name: VC2LV8U02-E05 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: using direct and indirect speech conventions, for example, Ba mẹ nói với tôi: “Con nên chăm học” vs. Ba mẹ bảo tôi nên chăm học

elaborations.name: VC2LV8U02-E06 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: using a range of expressions for indefinite quantities (e.g. hàng ngàn, triệu triệu, vô số, hằng hà sa số, biết bao nhiêu là)

elaborations.name: VC2LV8U02-E07 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: constructing a range of sentences in affirmative, negative, interrogative and imperative forms for different purposes, for example, Tuyệt vời!; Nhanh tay lên!; Sao chậm quá vậy?; Lạnh quá đi!

elaborations.name: VC2LV8U02-E08 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: differentiating interrogative forms with tag questions and using them according to context, for example, Em thích ăn cơm chiên/rang không? is a yes/no question to discover whether the other person likes fried rice, and Em thích ăn cơm chiên/rang phải không? is a tag question to confirm that the other person likes fried rice

elaborations.name: VC2LV8U02-E09 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: recognising differences in Vietnamese and English responses to negative tag questions to avoid misinterpretation, for example, in Vietnamese the response to the question Em chưa làm bài tập về nhà phải không? (You haven’t done your homework, have you?) would be Dạ phải. Em chưa làm. (Yes, I haven’t), while in English it would be ‘No, I haven’t’

elaborations.name: VC2LV8U02-E10 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: recognising the purpose and effect of exclamatory sentences as opposed to statements, for example, the statement Hôm nay Lan đi học sớm simply states that Lan came to school early today, while the exclamatory sentence Hôm nay Lan đi học sớm thế/vậy! may suggest surprise or irony

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2LV8U03 - Vietnamese F-10
substrand_content_descriptions.text: reflect on the structures and features of Vietnamese, and compare them with English and/or other languages, using some metalanguage

elaborations.name: VC2LV8U03-E01 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: identifying and comparing language features in Vietnamese and English texts, for example, the use of the first-person point of view and descriptive and emotive language in personal recounts and diary entries

elaborations.name: VC2LV8U03-E02 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: extending understanding of metalanguage to communicate in Vietnamese and English about word order, verbs and adjectives, for example, Tính từ luôn đi sau danh từ

elaborations.name: VC2LV8U03-E03 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: exploring the way content is developed in different types of texts in Vietnamese and English, and how ideas and information are structured, for example, identifying headings, paragraphs, topic sentences, elaborations and topic/idea shifts

elaborations.name: VC2LV8U03-E04 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: applying their understanding of key features of familiar types of Vietnamese and English texts to understand unfamiliar content, for example, in print and digital public announcements, commercials, advertisements or itineraries

elaborations.name: VC2LV8U03-E05 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: examining structural features of a range of informative and imaginative text types in both Vietnamese and English texts, for example, identifying elements such as paragraphing or conjunctions to sequence and link ideas for cohesion

elaborations.name: VC2LV8U03-E06 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: teaching younger students or non-Vietnamese speakers about some key differences between the Vietnamese and English languages, using support resources such as flashcards, diagrams, charts or tables

elaborations.name: VC2LV8U03-E07 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: comparing spoken and written Vietnamese and English texts, for example, a spoken and a print advertisement, or an oral conversation and an email, and explaining how mode relates to linguistic structures and features, and how this affects meaning

strand_substrands.substrand_tag: Understanding the interrelationship of language and culture

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2LV8U04 - Vietnamese F-10
substrand_content_descriptions.text: reflect on and explain how identity is shaped by language(s), culture(s), beliefs, attitudes and values
substrand_content_descriptions.sub_strand: Understanding the interrelationship of language and culture

elaborations.name: VC2LV8U04-E01 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: identifying Vietnamese and Australian cultural practices, attitudes, beliefs and values presented in diverse situations and contexts, such as in everyday conversations or in television programs, for example, standing up out of respect when an older person enters the room or the eldest person sitting down first

elaborations.name: VC2LV8U04-E02 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: reflecting on the influence of Vietnamese culture on their sense of identity and communication style, for example, discussing whether they modify their communication style, such as waving a hand instead of arm-crossing or head-bowing, when interacting in English-speaking contexts

elaborations.name: VC2LV8U04-E03 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: exploring the idea of having another identity when using Vietnamese, English or another language, for example, discussing the use of gestures in one language and not in another, or how they may communicate differently in the same situation in different languages

elaborations.name: VC2LV8U04-E04 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: discussing, in English, the concept of identity and the use of gender-neutral and gender-inclusive language in Vietnamese, for example, using học trò, học sinh or sinh viên to ensure all students are included

elaborations.name: VC2LV8U04-E05 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: discussing cultural cues in communication that suggest differences in ideas, traditions or values, for example, the importance of respect as seen in the way Vietnamese people greet each other or address older people (e.g. dạ / thưa / kính thưa)

elaborations.name: VC2LV8U04-E06 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: understanding that there is language variation across Vietnamese-speaking countries and regions, and reflecting on how this is similar to or different from the connections that Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander languages have with Country or Place

elaborations.name: VC2LV8U04-E07 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: comparing cultural elements reflected in language use and social norms, such as body language, volume of voice, and the use of personal space and silence, in different cultural contexts and exchanges

elaborations.name: VC2LV8U04-E08 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: recognising that some Vietnamese social behaviours may be misinterpreted as a lack of courtesy, for example, smiling instead of saying ‘thank you’, or not opening gifts straight away in front of guests

elaborations.name: VC2LV8U04-E09 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: sharing understandings of what culture is and of how it relates to language and identity, using statements such as Văn hóa và ngôn ngữ là đặc điểm quan trọng nhất của một quốc gia. Văn hóa tạo ra ngôn ngữ, ngôn ngữ tạo ra văn hóa.

elaborations.name: VC2LV8U04-E10 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: comparing Vietnamese and Australian cultural practices they see at home, at school or in the community, for example, ways of celebrating the New Year and birthdays

elaborations.name: VC2LV8U04-E11 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: analysing examples of traditional and contemporary images or texts in print and online, and comparing how representations of identity and gender in Vietnamese have changed over time

curriculum_band_description.body:
In Levels 9 and 10, Vietnamese language learning builds on each student’s prior learning and experiences. They continue to receive guidance, feedback and support from their peers and teachers. Students use Vietnamese to initiate and sustain interactions that communicate their own and others’ experiences of the world. They listen, speak, read, write and view to communicate with other speakers of Vietnamese in local and global settings through authentic community and secure, teacher-moderated online events. Background language learners and second or additional language learners may also support each other in their literacy development.

Students access and create written and spoken texts, increasingly of their own choosing. They access an increasing range of authentic and purpose-developed resources, which may include textbooks, audio and video clips, feature articles, television programs, simulated social media posts and other multimodal texts. Background language learners may source resources from their local and global communities to share with peers.

Students expand their knowledge and control of spoken and written Vietnamese language structures and features. They acknowledge that there are diverse influences on communication and cultural identity, and that these influences can shape their own behaviours, values and beliefs.

curriculum_achievement_standard.body:
By the end of Level 10, students contribute to and extend interactions in Vietnamese in increasingly unfamiliar contexts related to a wide range of interests and issues. They interpret and evaluate information, ideas and perspectives in texts. They contribute to discussions involving diverse views, negotiate outcomes and compare experiences. They demonstrate understanding of how features of language can be used to influence audience response. They create texts, selecting and manipulating language for a range of contexts, purposes and audiences. They apply and use complex sentences and structures to create and respond to spoken and written texts. They use a variety of tenses to sequence events and use language features to enhance meaning and cohesion.

Students incorporate features and conventions of spoken Vietnamese to enhance and extend fluency. They demonstrate understanding of the conventions of spoken and written texts, in both formal and informal contexts, and the connections between them. They apply knowledge of language, structures and features to make and predict meaning. They analyse Vietnamese texts using metalanguage. They reflect on their own cultural perspectives and identify and draw on their experience of learning Vietnamese to evaluate how this learning influences their ideas and ways of communicating.

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2LV10C01 - Vietnamese F-10
substrand_content_descriptions.text: initiate, sustain and extend exchanges in familiar and unfamiliar contexts related to their own and others’ experiences of the world, adjusting their language in response to others

elaborations.name: VC2LV10C01-E01 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: initiating and sustaining conversation by introducing topics, inviting contributions or asking for clarification, for example, Bạn nói vậy có nghĩa là sao?; Những nhà thiết kế thời trang giỏi cần có những tố chất hay kỹ năng gì?; Bạn nghĩ sao về ảnh hưởng của trò chơi điện tử đối với trẻ em?

elaborations.name: VC2LV10C01-E02 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: extending interactions in face-to-face or secure, teacher-moderated online discussions by inviting others to contribute or provide feedback on their own ideas, for example, Các bạn nghĩ sao về việc học thêm cuối tuần?; Chúng ta nên làm gì để giữ cho tình bạn được lâu dài?; Các bạn nghĩ gì về ý kiến của mình?

elaborations.name: VC2LV10C01-E03 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: exchanging ideas and elaborating on opinions in class discussions about issues associated with the school or local community, such as school facilities, local services or environmental issues, for example, Chúng em đề nghị căn-tin nhà trường nên bán nhiều thức ăn bổ dưỡng cho học sinh với giá rẻ hơn; Chúng em mong nhà trường sửa sang lại các phòng/nhà vệ sinh cho sạch sẽ hơn; Làm sao cải thiện ý thức bảo vệ môi trường của các bạn học sinh?

elaborations.name: VC2LV10C01-E04 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: using evaluative language to acknowledge strengths in others’ arguments or provide evidence to justify, contradict, challenge or rebut alternative views in a courteous manner, for example, hay / đúng / thú vị / hợp lý / công bằng lắm; Tôi rất thích cách giải thích của bạn, rõ ràng và hợp lý lắm; Bạn nói có lý nhưng tôi nghĩ rằng …; Lý thuyết thì như vậy, nhưng trên thực tế thì…; Hay là mình thử làm thế này / cách khác xem sao?

elaborations.name: VC2LV10C01-E05 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: using Vietnamese idioms and proverbs to illustrate ideas and opinions about learning, for example, Học thầy không tầy học bạn; Cần cù bù thông minh

elaborations.name: VC2LV10C01-E06 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: using sympathetic language to signal empathy, restraint or indirect disagreement, for example, Tôi hiểu. Tôi rất thông cảm với bạn …; Thôi bạn đừng buồn nữa …; Thôi được rồi, khoan đã

elaborations.name: VC2LV10C01-E07 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: adapting their own language use for different audiences or degrees of formality such as moving from informal to formal language, for example, mẹ ơi / ông ơi / bà ơi to thưa mẹ / kính thưa ông bà, or lòng thương người to lòng nhân ái

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2LV10C02 - Vietnamese F-10
substrand_content_descriptions.text: contribute to discussions that involve diverse views to negotiate outcomes, address issues and compare experiences

elaborations.name: VC2LV10C02-E01 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: organising and participating in real or simulated shopping experiences such as a class shopping trip to a market, using language for negotiating, bargaining, exchanging or returning goods, for example, Có thể giảm giá cho học sinh được không?; Tôi có thể trả lại đồ được không nếu lỡ/đã làm mất hóa đơn mua hàng?; Cái điện thoại này bị nứt màn hình, cô có thể đổi cái mới cho tôi được không?

elaborations.name: VC2LV10C02-E02 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: role-playing formal or informal negotiations, such as resolving a disagreement between parents and children or teacher and students, for example, Ba mẹ ơi, con muốn đi làm thêm cuối tuần. Không cần thiết đâu, con nên tập trung lo học đi; Thưa cô, vì máy vi tính bị hư nên em chưa làm bài xong, cô có thể cho em nộp bài ngày mai được không ạ?

elaborations.name: VC2LV10C02-E03 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: negotiating a particular course of action such as planning a day out with a guest, for example, Cuối tuần này có nhiều phim hay lắm, thời tiết cũng thích hợp để đi bơi nữa, các tiệm quần áo cũng đang giảm giá, nhóm mình muốn làm gì? Thôi mình lo đi mua đồ trước đi vì các tiệm chỉ giảm giá có ba ngày thôi, coi phim và đi bơi để tuần sau cũng được mà. Các bạn có đồng ý không?

elaborations.name: VC2LV10C02-E04 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: participating in simulated interviews and alternately taking the roles of prospective employer and job applicant, for example, Kinh nghiệm của em trong công việc này? Em có kinh nghiệm làm việc ở nhà hàng được hai năm rồi.

elaborations.name: VC2LV10C02-E05 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: devising a plan and solution for common problems or issues that young people may face such as a ‘pros and cons’ list, for example, lợi ích và tác hại của việc vừa đi học vừa đi làm

elaborations.name: VC2LV10C02-E06 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: making individual purchasing decisions by comparing items from a range of suppliers for features such as price, country of origin, quality, capacity for recycling, reliability, warranty and safety, for example, Tôi hay mua đồ điện tử ở tiệm / cửa hàng đó vì chất lượng cao mà giá cả lúc nào cũng rẻ hơn các tiệm khác; Những vật liệu này có thể tái chế được không?

elaborations.name: VC2LV10C02-E07 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: debating with peers on social, cultural, environmental or educational issues with reference to their own views and values, for example, Có nên bắt buộc học sinh học ngoại ngữ không?; Có phải vào đại học là con đuờng duy nhất dẫn đến thành công?

elaborations.name: VC2LV10C02-E08 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: being the teacher or buddy and annotating peers’ draft work, offering suggestions about the sequence of ideas, grammatical structures, paragraphs and layout

strand_substrands.substrand_tag: Mediating meaning in and between languages

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2LV10C03 - Vietnamese F-10
substrand_content_descriptions.text: interpret and evaluate information, ideas and perspectives in a broad range of spoken, written, viewed and multimodal texts and respond appropriately to context, purpose and audience
substrand_content_descriptions.sub_strand: Mediating meaning in and between languages

elaborations.name: VC2LV10C03-E01 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: viewing a range of media sources that present different perspectives on the same issue, such as songs, performances, television programs, advertisements, videos, films, images or documentaries, to discuss a subject such as deforestation, sustainable development or overpopulation, for example, Làm thế nào để giảm nạn phá rừng ở Việt Nam?; Làm thế nào để giảm bớt nạn cháy rừng ở Úc?; Làm thế nào để phân loại rác thải một cách hiệu quả nhất?

elaborations.name: VC2LV10C03-E02 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: viewing digital or multimodal texts such as infographics, documentaries or presentations, and then critically analysing the texts to prepare responses for a debate on a topic related to social or environmental issues, for example, Điện thoại di động nên bị cấm ở trường

elaborations.name: VC2LV10C03-E03 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: identifying and comparing how feelings and attitudes are expressed through visual images (e.g. symbolism, colours, composition) and language features (e.g. the use of emotive language in speeches, essays or stories), and then using these language features in their own texts, for example, Tôi thật hạnh phúc khi có mặt ở đây!

elaborations.name: VC2LV10C03-E04 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: listening to, viewing or reading Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander stories, and creating an author profile in Vietnamese that connects the themes and ideas from the text to the author’s life or values

elaborations.name: VC2LV10C03-E05 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: comparing the attitudes, beliefs, values and language of characters in traditional and contemporary Vietnamese arts and entertainment, for example, contrasting the original story 'Sự Tích Ông Táo' with its modern comic version, or comparing the way the same story is expressed in the film Ăn Khế Trả Vàng and in the folktale 'Ăn Khế Trả Vàng'

elaborations.name: VC2LV10C03-E06 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: conducting surveys and interviews with peers and organising information using graphic organisers, presenting perspectives on topics related to daily life in a pie chart based on the answers to questions, for example, Mỗi ngày bạn mất bao nhiêu thời gian lên mạng?; Bạn sử dụng máy vi tính để làm gì?; Theo bạn, làm thế nào để duy trì lối sống lành mạnh?

elaborations.name: VC2LV10C03-E07 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: analysing how authors manipulate language features, images, sounds and gestures in Vietnamese songs, picture books, comics, posters, films and performances for a purpose (e.g. to create humour or playfulness), and incorporating some of these elements in a short video or presentation

elaborations.name: VC2LV10C03-E08 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: investigating information about a significant Vietnamese person or character to create a text about them, for example, writing a script for an imagined interview with a person or character

elaborations.name: VC2LV10C03-E09 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: presenting information in a multimodal format about their family’s heritage by researching their own biographies, for example, by talking with relatives in Australia and elsewhere to know more about their history or circumstances

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2LV10C04 - Vietnamese F-10
substrand_content_descriptions.text: apply strategies to respond to non-verbal, spoken and written interactions and produce texts to convey meaning and intercultural understanding in familiar and unfamiliar contexts
substrand_content_descriptions.sub_strand: Mediating meaning in and between languages

elaborations.name: VC2LV10C04-E01 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: reading short texts and excerpts from a range of informative, personal and literary texts, identifying cultural elements and reflecting on how they are encoded differently in Vietnamese and English, for example, the use of family terms, titles and terms of address such as cô, chú, anh, chị and em

elaborations.name: VC2LV10C04-E02 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: translating written expressions associated with politeness and social behaviours in Vietnamese, for example, opening and closing formal/informal letters with phrases such as Kính thưa giám đốc; Ba mẹ kính yêu; Bạn thân mến; Thân / Thân mến / Thương mến; and Thân chào / Trân trọng kính chào, and comparing them with standard expressions in English, such as ‘Dear …’, ‘Yours sincerely/faithfully’ and ‘Kind regards / Regards’

elaborations.name: VC2LV10C04-E03 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: viewing English-language films or documentaries with Vietnamese subtitles and vice versa, evaluating the effectiveness of the translations and explaining associated cultural aspects, for example, a documentary about street food

elaborations.name: VC2LV10C04-E04 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: understanding and using common Sino-Vietnamese words appropriate to context, such as formal occasions, for example, hội phụ nữ, not hội đàn bà; viện dưỡng lão, not nhà người già

elaborations.name: VC2LV10C04-E05 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: translating a range of texts, such as advertisements, speeches, songs, and story or film extracts, and examining the appropriateness of translation for specific audiences and contexts

elaborations.name: VC2LV10C04-E06 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: analysing and discussing similarities, differences and cultural influences in common Vietnamese and English idiomatic expressions, for example, Có chí thì nên (Where there’s a will there’s a way); Đừng trông mặt mà bắt hình dong (Don’t judge a book by its cover); đẻ bọc điều (born with a silver spoon in one’s mouth); Dạy con từ thuở còn thơ (Strike while the iron is hot)

elaborations.name: VC2LV10C04-E07 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: exploring diverse ways in which meaning is conveyed in Vietnamese and English, such as the multiple meanings of words, for example, ‘old’ may be translated as già or cũ, and ngon as ‘tasty’, ‘delicious’, ‘mouth-watering’, ‘scrumptious’ or ‘rich’, and comparing synonyms for verbs, for example, comparing ‘running’, ‘sprinting’, ‘dashing’ and ‘jogging’ with chạy nhanh, chạy vụt and chạy bộ

elaborations.name: VC2LV10C04-E08 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: translating children’s stories from Vietnamese into English, and vice versa, and discussing how to maintain the original meaning when tailoring texts for different audiences and cultural backgrounds

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2LV10C05 - Vietnamese F-10
substrand_content_descriptions.text: create and present texts for diverse contexts and purposes, selecting vocabulary, expressions, grammatical structures and a range of textual conventions to engage different audiences

elaborations.name: VC2LV10C05-E01 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: producing a range of texts that reflect Vietnamese attitudes, beliefs and values, for diverse audiences and purposes, with consideration of textual features, for example, a multimedia presentation about the benefits of recycling or a speech about why they should be chosen to go on an exchange trip to Vietnam

elaborations.name: VC2LV10C05-E02 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: presenting about a social, environmental or cultural issue such as cyberbullying, using graphic organisers to display information and using appropriate referencing conventions

elaborations.name: VC2LV10C05-E03 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: viewing artwork from a local Aboriginal or Torres Strait Islander artist, and then writing the script of a speech to present to a group of Vietnamese speakers, introducing the artist and their work

elaborations.name: VC2LV10C05-E04 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: creating their own imaginative texts such as dialogues, poems, songs or short stories, using an array of cues (e.g. pictures, gestures, music, language) to convey different emotions such as love, happiness, excitement, frustration and sadness

elaborations.name: VC2LV10C05-E05 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: composing their own imaginative texts such as animated stories, games or short films, with different settings, characters and events, using a range of appropriate vocabulary and expressions, and audiovisual aids for effect

elaborations.name: VC2LV10C05-E06 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: creating performances that reflect on significant Vietnamese or Australian events or histories, for example, legends such as ‘Thánh Gióng’ and ‘Bánh chưng Bánh dày’, and events such as Tết Nguyên đán, Tết Trung thu, Anzac Day or Harmony Day

elaborations.name: VC2LV10C05-E07 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: composing spoken or written texts that reflect their own perspectives on Vietnamese attitudes, beliefs and values, such as traditional filial piety and the value of education in the modern context

elaborations.name: VC2LV10C05-E08 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: creating a multimedia self-profile that captures elements of the experience of learning an additional language or living across languages, communities and cultural traditions

elaborations.name: VC2LV10C05-E09 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: collaborating with peers to create their own dramatic or humorous representations of people, situations or events encountered in their own lives that reflect their experiences of living in a multicultural and multilingual society

elaborations.name: VC2LV10C05-E10 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: writing an autobiographical account to share with others, describing key milestones in their own life, such as a visit to family in Vietnam, attending a sporting event or a music concert; getting a learner’s permit; or participating in a cultural celebration, for example, their personal experience of attending the Moon Festival, Multicultural Day or Tết festival

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2LV10U01 - Vietnamese F-10
substrand_content_descriptions.text: apply features and conventions of spoken Vietnamese including intonation, tone, rhythm and sound to extend fluency, and to respond to and create a range of texts in familiar and unfamiliar contexts

elaborations.name: VC2LV10U01-E01 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: recognising and using rhythm in complex sentences, using pauses and intonation to signal clause boundaries and emphasis, for example, Con thích cái áo mà mẹ tặng cho con hôm sinh nhật vừa rồi

elaborations.name: VC2LV10U01-E02 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: applying knowledge of pronunciation, intonation, tone and pace to their own use of spoken Vietnamese for a range of social interactions, such as asking questions or expressing emotions, for example, expressing happiness, sadness, surprise or excitement in Bạn đi Việt Nam một mình hả? Thiệt/Thật không? Thật là tuyệt vời! Thiệt là bất ngờ!

elaborations.name: VC2LV10U01-E03 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: understanding the challenges of communication associated with clarity and pace in audio texts in certain situations such as station/airport announcements or recorded phone messages, for example, Thưa quý khách, chuyến bay VA123 sẽ khởi hành trong vòng ít phút nữa

elaborations.name: VC2LV10U01-E04 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: recognising that tone of voice can indicate the relationship between speakers, convey emotion and shape meaning, for example, distinguishing between a compliment and irony in the exclamatory sentence Hôm nay em đến sớm thế!

elaborations.name: VC2LV10U01-E05 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: experimenting with intonation and stress, improving coherence, and increasing expressive range by singing popular Vietnamese songs or by reading out loud from unfamiliar texts such as newspapers, novels and reports

elaborations.name: VC2LV10U01-E06 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: identifying the people and factors that influence their own Vietnamese language use and speech patterns, such as parents, teachers, peers and films

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2LV10U02 - Vietnamese F-10
substrand_content_descriptions.text: apply understanding of context and grammatical structures to predict meaning, and to respond to and create a range of texts that include some complex structures, ideas, and conventions appropriate to formality and text type

elaborations.name: VC2LV10U02-E01 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: understanding and using abstract nouns, adjectives and verbs to express sophisticated concepts and attitudes, for example, Không gì có thể sánh bằng công ơn và tình thương của cha mẹ đối với con cái

elaborations.name: VC2LV10U02-E02 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: using specialised vocabulary to discuss a range of topics of interest, such as the environment (e.g. ô nhiễm môi trường, tái chế, năng lượng sạch), technology (e.g. an toàn trên mạng, nhật ký điện tử, mạng lưới toàn cầu) and migration (e.g. tỵ nạn, di dân, định cư, hội nhập, thường trú nhân, quốc tịch)

elaborations.name: VC2LV10U02-E03 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: using stylistic devices used in Vietnamese to enhance communication, such as rhetorical questions (e.g. Chẳng lẽ mình là người Việt mà lại không biết nói tiếng Việt sao?), repetition (e.g. đi nhanh, ăn nhanh, nói nhanh), similes (e.g. đẹp như tiên) and personification (e.g. Hôm nay lạnh mặt trời đi ngủ sớm)

elaborations.name: VC2LV10U02-E04 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: using compound sentence structures to elaborate on ideas and clarify or justify opinions, for example, Con thích đi ăn ở nhà hàng mà mẹ tổ chức sinh nhật cho bà nội lúc bà qua Úc năm rồi vì chỗ đó thức ăn ngon mà lại rẻ nữa

elaborations.name: VC2LV10U02-E05 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: using a range of sentence endings to soften commands, for example, Học bài đi chứ!; Học bài đi nha!

elaborations.name: VC2LV10U02-E06 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: understanding and applying punctuation in writing, or adhering to punctuation conventions in reading, such as full stops, commas, exclamation marks, brackets, apostrophes, quotation marks and question marks

elaborations.name: VC2LV10U02-E07 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: comparing the meaning and use of Vietnamese and English conjunctions (e.g. càng … càng = ‘the more … the more …’ or ‘more and more’; vừa … vừa … = ‘both … and’; chẳng những … mà còn = ‘not only … but also’; không … mà cũng không = ‘neither … nor’), and using them in their own speech and writing

elaborations.name: VC2LV10U02-E08 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: sequencing and adding ideas, events and actions using a variety of cohesive devices such as ngoài ra, hơn nữa, tuy nhiên and bên cạnh đó

elaborations.elaboration_text: using pronouns that relate to a person’s position in the family or to extended family relationships (e.g. chị/cô/bà, anh/ông, anh Hai, chị Ba, cô Tư, chú Năm, ông Sáu, bà Bảy)

elaborations.name: VC2LV10U02-E10 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: using a range of words and expressions to express different levels of certainty in opinions, for example, Tôi đoán / nghĩ / tin / chắc chắn rằng …

elaborations.name: VC2LV10U02-E11 - Vietnamese F-10
elaborations.elaboration_text: using sympathetic language to signal empathy, restraint or indirect disagreement, for example, Tôi hiểu. Tôi rất thông cảm với bạn …; Thôi bạn đừng buồn nữa …; Thôi được rồi, khoan đã
